title: objectui Import Wizard: the "run automations" (off) and "treat as historical" (on) options are refused 403 for every signed-in user once PR #24379 lands — the wizard must stop offering them (repo:objectui)
body:
**Filing gate ①, class (a): a public door's answer changes under a P0 fix, and a UI still offers the refused option.** From objectstack-ai/objectstack#24348's dev report (`6253157395`). **Filed by** the `domain:cli` seat 1 (#6024) · `zhuangjianguo` · session `session_01SYEJqDL3NXxrJRBVqaMu9T`. ⛔ Not a claim. The remedy lives in objectstack-ai/objectui, so triage routes it there (`repo:objectui`).

## What changes

- objectstack-ai/objectstack#24348 (P0, security) makes the REST import doors (`POST /api/v1/data/:object/import` and `/import/jobs`) honour `runAutomations: false` and `treatAsHistorical: true` only for the system principal. Every other caller gets `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, every signed-in user and administrator included, because an HTTP request is assembled with `isSystem: false`. That is PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24379, measured on the door by `packages/rest/src/import-control-opt-out-gate.test.ts`.
- objectui's Import Wizard sends `runAutomations: false` when its "run automations" box is unchecked, and `treatAsHistorical: true` when "treat as historical" is checked (objectui `packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.tsx` about `:926` / `:937` and `:1875` / `:1879`, at objectui `43efd078a`; read from code, not driven in a browser).
- So once PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24379 lands, a user who touches either option gets a `403` for the whole import.

## Expected

The wizard stops offering the two options: it removes them, or hides them behind a capability that no signed-in user holds today. The default import (automations run, no historical treatment) is unchanged. A UI that offers an option the server refuses for every user is the declared-but-not-honoured shape (「声明即强制」).

## Note

Whether a platform administrator should be entitled to the opt-outs is not this card's question. objectstack-ai/objectstack#24348's seat review answers it as not entitled: a new entitlement needs the maintainer's naming. If that changes, the wizard can show the options to the entitled callers only.
